The classic route, paced for understanding rather than ticking off: Sultanate and Mughal Delhi, Agra and Fatehpur Sikri, and the planned city of Jaipur.

Everything is arranged privately for you: dates, pace, hotels, transport and the language you are guided in. You receive a day-by-day itinerary and an itemised quotation before you commit.

What it covers

  • Arrive in Delhi
  • Qutb and Mehrauli, or Humayun's Tomb
  • Old Delhi
  • To Agra

Day by day

  1. Day 1: Arrive in Delhi

    A briefing and time to rest.

  2. Day 2: Qutb and Mehrauli, or Humayun's Tomb

    Two monuments at a private pace.

  3. Day 3: Old Delhi

    The architecture and history of Shahjahanabad.

  4. Day 4: To Agra

    The drive to Agra, then its monuments after time to settle in.

  5. Day 5: Fatehpur Sikri and on to Jaipur

    Akbar's city on the way.

  6. Day 6: Jaipur

    The planned city and Jantar Mantar, then departure.

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Distinguish the Sultanate and Mughal phases of Delhi through the monuments you choose to visit.
  • Describe the architecture and history of Shahjahanabad in Old Delhi.
  • Compare Akbar's city at Fatehpur Sikri with the planned city of Jaipur and its Jantar Mantar.

You take away

Your own notes and observations from each site.
